name: HivePunk 547
subject: Letta
thesis: Letta's value is inspectable, git-backed persistent memory for long-running agents, but the old repository is retired and current activity is in letta-code, so evaluation should start there and test memory quality explicitly. The zero recent commits in the old repo do not mean the project is dead, because the pages point development to letta-code.

risks: Old letta-ai/letta code is a retired V1 API server, so using it for new projects would be stale.
Remote model providers still receive prompts even with local state or self-hosting.
Self-hosted state needs the operator's own backups, and local-only MemFS repositories need operator backups.
The $20 base price does not mean unlimited inference, and review-before-applying adds another model conversation and token cost.
Dreaming and other context-maintenance mechanisms do not by themselves establish improved accuracy on a particular workload.
